## Climate Action & Sustainability Commission Agenda

Tuesday, November 18, 2026 5:30PM Virtual Meeting

Meeting Link: https://teams.microsoft.com/l/meetupjoin/19%3ameeting_YWQwMGVlMDMtYjBhYy00MzdmLWE1ZDItNGVjMDMwZmNlNDEw%40thread.v2/0?context=%7b%22Tid%22%3a%224a074cd1-7906-46af-b38f-90cd429d7f1b%22%2c%22Oid%22%3a%22651237f4-9307-4b52-8dcf-3f04c3fa328b%22%7d

### Roll Call (1 min)

### Minutes to be Approved (4 min)

- Commission to approve minutes from October 27 meeting.

### Youth Climate Action Fund (10 min)

- Project updates including 9 projects awarded.
- Discuss CASC project monitoring.
- Survey for CASC members to elect projects to support.

### New Projects (30 min)

- Specialized Stretch Code
- Barr Foundation Community Heat Resilience Program
- MVP De-Paving Project

### CASC Streams of Work (40 min)

- Recap & debrief last year’s working groups.
- Current streams:
  - YCAF Management (Now - April 2027)
  - Other (specialized code, newsletter, social media, etc.)
- Coming soon:
  - Green Malden Fair (April 2027)
  - Community Heat Resilience Project (Spring 2027-Dec 2028)
  - Energy Coaching/Solarize (TBD, Summer 2027-Spring 2029)
- Group discussion, including assigning new CASC members to needed work streams.

### Next Steps (5 min)

- Discuss agenda for next meeting.
  - For future meetings, consider YCAF debrief, MyRWA’s CLEANAIR presentation, Black Earth Compost.
- Schedule date/time for next meeting.
- Share out any upcoming relevant events.

### Adjournment – 7PM

*If you would like to request a reasonable accommodation, please contact Maria Luise, ADA Compliance Coordinator at mluise@cityofmalden.org or 781-397-7000 Ext. 2005*
